colors.case: matte black top case with white silkscreen port labels (SWD, BOOT, USB, 5V, DBUS, RST, PWM, CAN1, CAN2, UART1, UART2, KEY) and white 'R ROBOMASTER' logo

notes: Official Creo export by camaro.ren 2020-01-07 ('mounting the board type C' assembly). Product names are generic ('1_0'..'4_0'); roles inferred from geometry. ref.png is the 4429 x 4429 official render (6.6 MB). The 4_0 corner parts may be mounting hardware rather than part of the board itself; the manual says screws and copper pillars are not included.
